allowed_uses: ML-04 through ML-07 historical development and walk-forward evaluation
forbidden_uses: prospective shadow input after a model package is frozen
historical_development_source.selection_rule: Historical builders must receive this directory explicitly. They must never recursively discover live goldsharp files from the parent Files directory.

live_operational_source.location_rule: Only Files-root goldsharp_*.csv files are live inputs. The gold_v3_2023_2026 subdirectory is excluded from live discovery.
allowed_uses: future ML-08 audit-only shadow feature construction
future live inference only after all separate activation gates pass

shared_semantic_contract.higher_timeframe_use: only bars with close_time less than or equal to decision_time
shared_semantic_contract.exact_m1: mandatory when the stage requires entry or label evaluation; missing exact M1 means skip
shared_semantic_contract.feature_logic: The same frozen causal feature definitions must be used for historical and live data. Only the source adapter and snapshot-identity policy differ.

adapter_policy.historical_adapter: hash-locked fixed-snapshot reader used by current ML-02 and ML-03 builders
adapter_policy.live_adapter: not yet implemented; must read only explicit Files-root goldsharp_*.csv paths and must not use recursive globbing
adapter_policy.manifest_requirement: Every produced registry or prediction batch must record source role, resolved paths, first/last timestamp, row counts and source-file hashes.
